purpose: Correct two cutscene artworks to include the supplied SORA emblem geometry.

sourceReference.inspection: Viewed at original resolution before editing. Red disk; equal straight white horizontal bars; central stem; broad straight white diagonal channels cut through lower disk circumference.

policy.method: Each edit used original cutscene plus supplied logo as referenced local images. Final files are byte-for-byte copies of accepted built-in generated PNG outputs. No manual compositing, resizing, recoloring or raster processing.
policy.acceptance: At least one clearly recognizable supplied geometric emblem in each artwork, allowing scene perspective and lighting. No pixel-identical source-logo claim; generated interpretations remain painterly.
policy.scope: Only two new versioned PNGs and this provenance; runtime references left to parent integration.

attempts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Asset: existing wide anime cutscene, precise local branding correction. Image 1 is the edit target; image 2 is the exact supplied SORA emblem to insert. Preserve the entire image 1 composition, framing, people, faces, clothing, returned brass key resting on the cream envelope, notebook, table, sunset windows, colors and painterly texture. Correct the small wrong font-like symbol on the woman's visible sleeve: place a neat white rectangular printed fabric badge on that same sleeve, with the supplied image-2 red circular emblem reproduced faithfully and clearly at its center. It must be the reference's geometric mark: two equal-length, square-ended straight white bars, central vertical joining stem, two straight white diagonal openings that cut through the lower boundary of the red disk. Do not substitute the kanji 天 or any font glyph, do not curve the legs or close the lower openings. Match the sleeve angle and warm light while keeping the logo's geometry crisply readable. This is a logo insert only; no other new objects, no extra text, no narrative or camera changes. Preserve wide landscape aspect ratio.
attempts.reason: Lower white strokes ended inside an unbroken red circle, retaining the inaccurate font-like construction. Also added a stronger bottom vignette. Preserved as rejected generation.
